==90%==
Oliver, Emily and Rosie count from 1 to 20 taking it in turns to say the numbers. Oliver says 1, Emily says 2, Rosie says 3 and so on. Who will say the number 20?

As there are three of them, they will count to 18 in order, finishing with Rosie. Then Oliver will say 19 and '''Emily''' will say 20.

==10%==
Eric the zoo keeper’s favourite photo is the one with him and his six cows, three spiders, four ostriches, five elephants and his giant tortoise all together. How many legs are in the photo?

6 cows  = 24 legs<br>3 spiders  = 24 legs<br>4 ostriches  = 8 legs<br>5 elephants  = 20 legs<br>1 giant tortoise  = 4 legs<br>Eric  = 2 legs<br>Total  = '''82''' legs
